title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: STRIDE：面向智能体强化学习的策略到战术检索引导式技能披露与演化
abstract_en: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-bank evolution. On ALFWorld, STRIDE achieves a 92.7% average success rate with Qwen3-4B and a 94.9% average success rate with Qwen3-8B. On WebShop, it improves over the strongest reproduced skill-augmented baseline by 4.5 score points and 1.9 success-rate percentage points. These results show that skill reuse is most effective when persistent strategies preserve global task structure and tactics are disclosed only at local decision bottlenecks.
abstract_zh: 技能增强强化学习让大语言模型智能体能够跨回合复用解题经验，但现有方法通常使用扁平的技能库，并仅依据回合结果更新技能，难以区分贯穿全局的策略与处理局部执行难点的战术。STRIDE 将技能分阶段呈现：选定的策略在整个回合中保持可见，战术起初只以精简菜单呈现，完整内容仅在智能体显式检索后加载。每次检索都成为一个独立的信用分配单元，既提供过程反馈，帮助智能体学习何时检索，也为技能库更新提供依据。在 ALFWorld 上，Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的平均成功率分别达到 92.7% 和 94.9%；在 WebShop 上，相比最强的复现技能增强基线，得分提高 4.5 分，成功率提高 1.9 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 区分两类可复用经验：策略维持全局任务结构，战术解决局部执行难点。
采用渐进式技能披露：持续展示选定策略，先提供精简战术菜单，再按显式检索加载完整内容。
将信用分配细化到每次检索，用过程反馈学习检索时机，并为技能库更新积累证据。
ALFWorld 上，Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的平均成功率分别为 92.7% 和 94.9%；WebShop 上，相比最强的复现技能增强基线，得分和成功率分别提高 4.5 分和 1.9 个百分点。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用检索事件的过程反馈训练智能体何时检索，并为更新可复用技能库提供依据。相比扁平技能池，STRIDE 保持全局策略可见，仅在显式检索后加载完整战术。WebShop 的量化基线对比支持整体方法，但摘录未报告消融，无法区分各组件的作用，也未表明改进机制本身会演化。
